lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Missile inbound on Finch! It went straight through my shield. Captain—

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Finch is gone. No pod. Captain, there's no pod.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It hit Finch from outside our sensor range. It's picking off the small ships first.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Wren, Kite: close on Kestrel. Nobody else goes alone.
